title: Chemical extraction of sulfachloropyridazine from muscle samples
author: Ekaterina Pokrant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pvcdn2w
materials: Sodium hydroxide Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1064981000
Hydrochloric acid fuming 37% Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1003172500

Reconstitute the sample with 500 µL of a mixture of mobile phase A and B (15/85). Mobile phase A: 0.1% formic acid in methanol (pH 2.9 ± 0.3). Mobile phase B: 0.1% formic acid in water (pH 2.7 ± 0.2). Formic Acid 98-100% Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #100264 Methanol J.T. Baker Catalog #9093-03 Water Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1153334000

steps.title: Weigh muscle sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 5 ± 0.05 g of muscle tissue into a 50 mL polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Add internal standard and controls
steps.instruction: Fortify the weighed sample with the internal‑standard solution Sulfamethazine-(phenyl‑13C6) hemihydrate (SMZ‑13C6); for positive‑control tubes, add the analyte Sulfamethazine.

steps.title: Dissolve gel and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Gently shake the tube by hand to dissolve the resulting gel, then centrifuge at 2,790 g for 10 min.

steps.title: Extract with ethyl acetate
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 50 mL polypropylene tube. Add 10 mL ethyl acetate (J.T. Baker Catalog #9280‑03) and repeat the extraction two additional times, collecting each extract so that a total of 30 mL ethyl acetate is combined in the new tube.

steps.title: Evaporate solvent
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined ethyl acetate extracts using a water bath set to 40–50 °C while applying a mild nitrogen flow.

steps.title: Reconstitute and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Transfer the dried residue to an Eppendorf tube, reconstitute (solvent not specified in the source), and centrifuge at 17,000 g for 10 min.

steps.title: Filter sample
steps.instruction: Filter the centrifuged solution through a 13 mm Millex filter with a 0.22 µm PVDF membrane and collect the filtrate into glass vials.
